_comment: Hand-written network-exit oracle (roadmap #38). Every host the runtime can SEND a request to (fetch, script injection target, iframe/img subresource) must be listed under exits with its trigger surface and privacy.md coverage; hosts that appear in code only as outbound links / site-rule matchers / attribution URLs go under nonExitHosts. scripts/network-exits-check.mjs cross-checks: (1) every literal https host in runtime scripts is classified here, (2) every exit host (or its user-facing disclosedAs name) is mentioned in docs/privacy.md, (3) every manifest static host is a listed exit. Deliberately NOT generated from source — that would only prove the code agrees with itself. Update this file in the same commit as any new data exit, and privacy.md with it (release docs gate).

api.pinboard.in.purpose: Pinboard v1 API — every bookmark read/write (required host)

pinboard.in.purpose: Pinboard site — content scripts, tag pages, cookie-based Save Tab Set (required host)

r.jina.ai.purpose: Jina Reader — fallback article extraction (optional, user-triggered)

www.googleapis.com.purpose: Google Drive appData vocabulary sync (optional exact-origin grant)

api.frdic.com.purpose: Eudic OpenAPI — send vocabulary / connection test (optional exact-origin grant)

www.youtube.com.purpose: YouTube caption chain — tab injection / extension-page fetch (optional exact-origin grant)

i.ytimg.com.purpose: YouTube thumbnails — subresource of the reader's video panel (no host grant needed)

pine2d.github.io.purpose: This project's Pages relay — embeds the YouTube player iframe (no host grant needed)

api.bilibili.com.purpose: Bilibili subtitle APIs (optional exact-origin grant, credentials included)

player.bilibili.com.purpose: Bilibili player bridge — playback sync content script (optional exact-origin grant)

generativelanguage.googleapis.com.purpose: AI provider: Gemini (BYO key, user-selected, default)

open.bigmodel.cn.purpose: AI provider: Zhipu BigModel (BYO key, user-selected)

api.moonshot.cn.purpose: AI provider: Moonshot Kimi (BYO key, user-selected)

userConfiguredExits: custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, non-loopback Ollama, webhook export target and batch-save tab origins are user-supplied at runtime; the endpoint validator enforces HTTPS (loopback-literal HTTP only) and runtime grants are exact origins — see CLAUDE.md 跨领域安全铁律 and privacy.md.

nonExitHosts.www.bilibili.com: outbound link the user opens (Open on bilibili, timestamp deep links)
nonExitHosts.notebooklm.google.com: send-to target opened as a browser tab, no fetch
nonExitHosts.www.mdbg.net: dictionary attribution link the user opens
nonExitHosts.en.wiktionary.org: dictionary attribution link the user opens
nonExitHosts.cc-cedict.org: license attribution link the user opens
